import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
expected=r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'
if bpy.data.filepath.lower()!=expected.lower(): raise RuntimeError('arquivo errado')
parts=[bpy.data.objects[n] for n in ['OFICIAL | Torre externa | parede frontal','OFICIAL | Torre externa | parede posterior','OFICIAL | Torre externa | lateral externa','OFICIAL | Torre externa | lateral acima da porta'] if bpy.data.objects.get(n)]
pts=[]
for o in parts: pts += [o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
center=Vector(((min(p.x for p in pts)+max(p.x for p in pts))/2,(min(p.y for p in pts)+max(p.y for p in pts))/2,(min(p.z for p in pts)+max(p.z for p in pts))/2))
front=[bpy.data.objects[n] for n in ['OFICIAL | Entrada superior | fachada esquerda','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | fachada direita'] if bpy.data.objects.get(n)]
fpts=[]
for o in front: fpts += [o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
fcenter=Vector(((min(p.x for p in fpts)+max(p.x for p in fpts))/2,(min(p.y for p in fpts)+max(p.y for p in fpts))/2,(min(p.z for p in fpts)+max(p.z for p in fpts))/2))
lat0=-12.9745411;lon0=-38.5129247;lat=-12.97409;lon=-38.51336;R=6378137.0
osmx=math.radians(lon-lon0)*R*math.cos(math.radians(lat0));osmy=math.radians(lat-lat0)*R
print('TOWER_WORLD_CENTER',tuple(round(v,4) for v in center))
print('UPPER_FRONT_WORLD_CENTER',tuple(round(v,4) for v in fcenter))
print('CURRENT_PLAN_DISTANCE',round(((fcenter.x-center.x)**2+(fcenter.y-center.y)**2)**0.5,4))
print('OSM_WAY59224731_PROJECTED_APPROX',round(osmx,4),round(osmy,4))
print('TOWER_MINUS_OSM',round(center.x-osmx,4),round(center.y-osmy,4),'DIST',round(((center.x-osmx)**2+(center.y-osmy)**2)**0.5,4))
print('ANCHOR_COMPARE_DONE')
